summary.en: The one dot of the ink style: the full stop of the word it ends, landing with a squash, bursting as a ring, ending as the closing command's cursor.
summary.zh: ink 风格唯一的墨点：它结束的那个词的句号，落下时压扁，炸开成圆环，最后变成结尾命令的光标。

fits: Any ink scene: the full stop, the progress dot, the playhead, the cursor.

intent.en: One mark the eye follows through the whole film.
intent.zh: 一个视线能从头跟到尾的标记。

content.en: The word it ends (≤ 8 chars) or a command.
content.zh: 它结束的那个词（≤ 4 字）或一行命令。

fits.zh: 任何 ink 场景：句号、进度点、播放头、光标。

en: One dot in the frame at a time (the split stops merge back into one).
zh: 画面里同一时间只有一个墨点（分裂的句号最后要并回一个）。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
